keyPoints.en: Hydrostatic skeleton: fluid under pressure in the body cavity, surrounded by muscles (earthworm).
keyPoints.bm: Rangka hidrostatik: bendalir bertekanan dalam rongga badan, dikelilingi otot (cacing tanah).

keyPoints.en: Exoskeleton: hard chitin outer layer — protects, prevents water loss; must moult to grow (insects, crabs).
keyPoints.bm: Rangka luar: lapisan luar kitin yang keras — melindungi, mengelak kehilangan air; mesti bersalin kulit untuk membesar (serangga, ketam).

keyPoints.en: Endoskeleton: bone and cartilage inside the body; grows with the animal (fish, birds, mammals).
keyPoints.bm: Rangka dalam: tulang dan rawan di dalam badan; membesar bersama haiwan (ikan, burung, mamalia).

keyPoints.en: All skeletons give support, shape and points for muscles to pull against.
keyPoints.bm: Semua rangka memberi sokongan, bentuk dan tempat untuk otot menarik.

question.en: Why can't insects grow very large?
question.bm: Mengapa serangga tidak boleh membesar dengan sangat besar?

answer.en: A large exoskeleton would be too heavy, and gas exchange by tracheae only works over short distances.
answer.bm: Rangka luar yang besar terlalu berat, dan pertukaran gas melalui trakea hanya berkesan pada jarak pendek.

tip.en: Compare skeleton types using: material, location, growth, example.
tip.bm: Bandingkan jenis rangka menggunakan: bahan, lokasi, pertumbuhan, contoh.

keyPoints.en: Axial skeleton: skull, vertebral column (cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacrum, coccyx), ribs, sternum.
keyPoints.bm: Rangka paksi: tengkorak, turus vertebra (serviks, toraks, lumbar, sakrum, koksiks), rusuk, sternum.

keyPoints.en: Appendicular skeleton: limbs plus pectoral (shoulder) and pelvic (hip) girdles.
keyPoints.bm: Rangka apendikular: anggota serta lengkungan pektoral (bahu) dan pelvis (pinggul).

keyPoints.en: Joints: immovable (skull), slightly movable (vertebrae), freely movable synovial (ball-and-socket, hinge).
keyPoints.bm: Sendi: tidak bergerak (tengkorak), sedikit bergerak (vertebra), bebas bergerak sinovia (lesung, engsel).

keyPoints.en: Synovial joint: cartilage cushions, synovial fluid lubricates, ligaments hold bones together.
keyPoints.bm: Sendi sinovia: rawan sebagai kusyen, bendalir sinovia melincirkan, ligamen memegang tulang bersama.

keyPoints.en: Muscle types: skeletal (voluntary), smooth (involuntary, organ walls), cardiac (heart).
keyPoints.bm: Jenis otot: rangka (terkawal), licin (luar kawal, dinding organ), kardium (jantung).

question.en: Why do athletes warm up before exercise?
question.bm: Mengapa atlet memanaskan badan sebelum bersenam?

answer.en: It increases blood flow and synovial fluid, making muscles and joints more flexible and less likely to be injured.
answer.bm: Ia meningkatkan aliran darah dan bendalir sinovia, menjadikan otot dan sendi lebih fleksibel dan kurang berisiko cedera.

tip.en: Tendon: muscle-to-bone (both have 't' and 'm'... think 'Tendon Tugs'). Ligament: Links bones.
tip.bm: Tendon: otot ke tulang. Ligamen: menghubung tulang dengan tulang.

keyPoints.en: Muscles can only pull, so they work in antagonistic pairs.
keyPoints.bm: Otot hanya boleh menarik, jadi bekerja secara berpasangan antagonistik.

keyPoints.en: Bending the arm: biceps contracts, triceps relaxes. Straightening: triceps contracts, biceps relaxes.
keyPoints.bm: Membengkokkan lengan: biseps mengecut, triseps mengendur. Meluruskan: triseps mengecut, biseps mengendur.

keyPoints.en: Earthworm: circular and longitudinal muscles alternate; chaetae anchor segments.
keyPoints.bm: Cacing tanah: otot membulat dan memanjang berselang-seli; seta menambat segmen.

keyPoints.en: Fish: myotome muscle blocks on each side contract alternately; tail fin pushes against water.
keyPoints.bm: Ikan: blok otot miotom di setiap sisi mengecut berselang-seli; sirip ekor menolak air.

keyPoints.en: Birds: large pectoral muscles move wings; grasshoppers: powerful hind-leg muscles for jumping.
keyPoints.bm: Burung: otot pektoral besar menggerakkan sayap; belalang: otot kaki belakang yang kuat untuk melompat.

question.en: Which muscles contract when you kick a ball (straighten the knee)?
question.bm: Otot manakah mengecut apabila menendang bola (meluruskan lutut)?

answer.en: Quadriceps (front of thigh) contract; hamstrings (back) relax.

tip.en: Always state BOTH muscles — which contracts AND which relaxes.
tip.bm: Sentiasa nyatakan KEDUA-DUA otot — yang mengecut DAN yang mengendur.

keyPoints.en: Osteoporosis: bone density falls → brittle bones (elderly, post-menopausal women).
keyPoints.bm: Osteoporosis: ketumpatan tulang menurun → tulang rapuh (warga emas, wanita selepas menopaus).

keyPoints.en: Arthritis: osteoarthritis (cartilage wears away), rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune joint inflammation).
keyPoints.bm: Artritis: osteoartritis (rawan haus), artritis reumatoid (keradangan sendi autoimun).

keyPoints.en: Scoliosis (sideways curve), kyphosis (hunched back), lordosis — linked to poor posture and heavy school bags.
keyPoints.bm: Skoliosis (lengkung ke sisi), kifosis (bongkok), lordosis — dikaitkan dengan postur buruk dan beg sekolah berat.

keyPoints.en: Muscle cramps (lactic acid, dehydration), sprains (torn ligaments), fractures.
keyPoints.bm: Kejang otot (asid laktik, dehidrasi), terseliuh (ligamen koyak), patah tulang.

keyPoints.en: Prevention: calcium, vitamin D, regular exercise, correct posture, proper lifting technique.
keyPoints.bm: Pencegahan: kalsium, vitamin D, senaman berkala, postur betul, teknik mengangkat yang betul.

question.en: Give two ways teenagers can protect their spine.
question.bm: Berikan dua cara remaja boleh melindungi tulang belakang.

answer.en: Carry bags on both shoulders (not too heavy) and sit upright when studying.
answer.bm: Galas beg pada kedua-dua bahu (tidak terlalu berat) dan duduk tegak semasa belajar.

tip.en: Bone mass peaks around age 30 — build it now with calcium and exercise!
tip.bm: Jisim tulang mencapai kemuncak sekitar umur 30 — bina sekarang dengan kalsium dan senaman!
